description: This file defines an interface IPluginStarter for starting or activating plugins, with a method activatePlugin that attempts activation with retries.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: Interface to start a specified plugin, which can be implemented with JSON-RPC or COM-RPC.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a Thunder plugin with retry logic, blocking until success or maximum retries reached.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Pure virtual method to activate a plugin with retries.
